title: Phase 0: chapter list/detail view with edit & delete
description: Property dashboard listing chapters (filter by type/status). Chapter detail view: photo grid, edit chapter title/description/type, delete chapter, edit/delete individual photos, reassign a photo to a different chapter. This is the 'basic organization' + 'ease of editing' piece Pete specifically wants to validate first.

title: Phase 0: review/confirm UI before saving AI suggestions
description: After Claude analyzes uploaded photos, show its suggested chapter_type/title/description/extracted fields and let the user edit any of it before confirming. On confirm: either create a new chapter or attach to an existing open one. This is the core 'won't get it right the first time' safety valve — must be fast, not a big form.

title: Phase 0: Claude Vision analysis edge function
description: Edge Function that takes pending media (+ any user note) and calls Claude to produce: suggested chapter_type, title, description, and type-specific extracted fields (e.g. paint color name/code if a paint can, brand/model if an appliance is visible). For a batch upload, propose whether photos form one chapter with a timeline. Store result on media.ai_description/ai_extracted, don't auto-create the chapter yet — that's the review step's job.
close_reason: analyze-media edge function deployed: runs under caller's own JWT (no service-role bypass), downloads photo, calls Claude with a forced tool-use categorize_photo call, stores suggestion on the media row. Verified end-to-end in browser.

title: Phase 0: photo capture/upload UI (single + batch)
description: Page for taking/uploading one or many photos with an optional free-text note at submit time. Must support the batch-upload case (dozens of renovation photos at once) as well as single quick captures (one paint can photo). Stores to Storage + creates media rows with status=pending_review, chapter_id null until AI/review step assigns one.
close_reason: Upload UI built: single+batch file input, optional batch note, uploads to houstory-media storage + creates media rows, triggers analysis, renders suggestions.

title: Phase 0: core schema (properties, chapters, media)
description: Write initial Supabase migration(s): properties (seed with 1075 Newark Granville Road, Granville, OH), property_members (single owner row for now), chapters (property_id, chapter_type free-text, title, description, status, cost fields, metadata jsonb), media (property_id, chapter_id nullable, kind, storage_path, caption, ai_description, ai_extracted jsonb, status). Set up a Storage bucket for photos/docs. Wire basic Supabase Auth (email magic link) since RLS needs auth.uid() even for a single user.
close_reason: Core schema (properties, property_members, chapters, media) migrated, private storage bucket set up, RLS tested end-to-end via login+create-property flow in browser. Two RLS gotchas found & fixed (see migrations 003/004: AFTER INSERT triggers fire after RETURNING's SELECT-policy check, not before).

title: Houstory v1: photo-first capture, AI categorization, flexible chapters
description: Core product direction: user captures/uploads photos, Claude interprets/categorizes/describes them, stored as flexible 'chapters' (renovation, paint, appliance, landscaping, research, general) under a property. See design discussion 2026-07-26 for full data model (properties, property_members, chapters w/ jsonb metadata, media, chapter_events, ai_credentials) and phasing.

title: Claude-assisted photo description/categorization
description: Add an Edge Function (supabase/functions/) that calls the Claude API when a photo is uploaded, to auto-generate a description and category (renovation/landscaping/paint/appliance/etc). This is the core differentiating feature of Houstory vs a plain photo album.
close_reason: Superseded by detailed data-model/UX design discussion — replaced with phased epic+children

title: Design core schema (homes, photos, renovation/landscaping projects, paint colors, appliances)
description: Design and write the initial Supabase migration(s) under supabase/migrations/ for Houstory's core data model: homes, photo records (with storage bucket refs), renovation projects, landscaping projects, paint colors, appliances. Mirror five-wonders' migration style (numbered, sequential .sql files).
close_reason: Superseded by detailed data-model/UX design discussion — replaced with phased epic+children

title: Scaffold Houstory infra to mirror Five Wonders
description: Set up GitHub repo, Supabase project, static site skeleton, and domain wiring for Houstory, following the pattern used in five-wonders (static HTML/CSS/JS + Supabase + GitHub Pages custom domain).
close_reason: Repo, Supabase project, and static-site scaffold created; follow-up feature work filed as separate issues

title: Phase 1: chapter timeline (explicit events + photo-date ordering)
description: Add chapter_events table for explicit timeline entries (e.g. 'demo started', 'cabinets installed'), and auto-order a chapter's photo grid by taken_at/upload date to give renovation portfolios a natural timeline view.

title: Phase 1: receipt/invoice capture + cost rollup
description: Support photographing/uploading receipts and invoices as media (kind=document). Claude extracts amount/vendor/date into ai_extracted. Roll these up into a chapter's actual_cost total.

title: Phase 1: paint color extraction refinement
description: Improve paint-can photo analysis to reliably extract brand, color name, color code/hex, sheen. Let the user's submit-time note (e.g. 'used in kids bedroom') get folded into the chapter description/metadata.

title: Phase 1: appliance enrichment (recalls, manuals, warranty, repair pros)
description: When Claude identifies an appliance (brand/model from photo, or from an uploaded receipt), use web search to find recall notices, the manual, warranty info, and suggest local repair contacts. Store as links/structured data in the chapter's metadata jsonb.

title: Build initial site pages (add/view home entries, upload photos)
description: Replace the placeholder index.html with real pages mirroring five-wonders' page-per-feature pattern (index, add-item, view, profile, etc), backed by the Supabase schema and Edge Functions once those land.
close_reason: Superseded by detailed data-model/UX design discussion — replaced with phased epic+children

title: Wire up houstory.app custom domain
description: Once houstory.app is registered, add a CNAME file to the repo root (like five-wonders' CNAME -> fivewonders.app), point DNS at GitHub Pages, and set the custom domain in repo Settings > Pages.
close_reason: Domain purchased as houstory.homes (not .app). CNAME file added and GitHub Pages custom domain set to houstory.homes. DNS records still need to be added at Namecheap.

title: Phase 3: research a property's history via web search
description: On-demand 'Research my home' action: Claude + web search produces a chapter_type=research chapter with a sourced summary (build date, past owners/events if publicly findable) for a property, clearly labeled as AI-researched with source links, not authoritative record.

title: Phase 3: bring-your-own Claude API key
description: Settings UI for a user to provide their own Anthropic API key so Houstory's AI usage runs on their account/billing rather than the app's. Store the key via Supabase Vault (encrypted at rest), mask in UI, never log it. Update the Vision/analysis edge functions to use the user's key when present.

title: Phase 2: Google account sign-in
description: Add Google OAuth as a sign-in option alongside (or replacing) email magic link auth, per Pete's eventual preference for Google-based signup/profile.

title: Phase 2: multi-property + property member invites
description: Let a user own/belong to multiple properties (property switcher UI), and invite other users to a property via email with a role (owner/member/viewer), using the property_members table already in the Phase 0 schema.

title: Verify beads setup
description: This ticket is simply to chack that bd ready works.
